# NEW 2026-11-23 v16.0 Module 16.0-D: Byzantine Diocese Katepanate Voluntary Consolidation (oe_kat_, Scheme 3A Phase 2, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v160_katepanate.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Synchronizes Imperial Katepanate Synergy on BYZ and subject modifiers on active Katepanates.
oe_kat_sync_modifiers = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_kat_active_count >= 1 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_kat_imperial_synergy_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_kat_imperial_synergy_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_kat_imperial_synergy_mod
		}
	}
	every_subject = {
		limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:oe_kat_is_katepanate ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod
		}
	}
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_kat_minor = ordinary theme to absorb, scope:oe_kat_lead = receiving Katepanate theme.
# Uses the exact Theme 2.0 absorbed region/seat variables so oe_t2_do_split_theme & oe_kat_do_dissolve_katepanate stay 100% reversible.
oe_kat_absorb_one_theme = {
	scope:oe_kat_minor = {
		if = { limit = { exists = capital } capital = { save_scope_as = oe_kat_old_seat } }
		ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_kat_former_strat }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_kat_xfer_gold value = oe_t2_half_gold }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_kat_xfer_mp value = oe_t2_half_manpower }
		every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ }
			oe_t2_construct_matching_post = { owner = scope:oe_kat_lead }
		}
		every_army = { change_unit_owner = scope:oe_kat_lead }
		every_navy = { change_unit_owner = scope:oe_kat_lead }
	}
	scope:oe_kat_lead = {
		add_gold = scope:oe_kat_xfer_gold
		add_manpower = scope:oe_kat_xfer_mp
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_kat_minor = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region value = scope:oe_kat_minor.var:oe_theme_region_id }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_kat_old_seat }
				set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat value = scope:oe_kat_old_seat }
				scope:oe_kat_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_kat_minor = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 value = scope:oe_kat_minor.var:oe_theme_region_id }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_kat_old_seat }
				set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_2 value = scope:oe_kat_old_seat }
				scope:oe_kat_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_kat_minor = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 value = scope:oe_kat_minor.var:oe_theme_region_id }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_kat_old_seat }
				set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_3 value = scope:oe_kat_old_seat }
				scope:oe_kat_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 3 }
		}
		set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
	}
	scope:oe_kat_former_strat ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes }
			move_country = c:BYZ
			reset_ruler_title = {}
		}
	}
	annex_country = { country = scope:oe_kat_minor reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
}

# BYZ scope; single bounded consolidation pass into scope:oe_kat_lead (strictly preserves Naval/Hereditary/Revolt themes).
oe_kat_consolidate_one_pass = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:oe_kat_lead = {
				oe_t2_receiver_under_region_cap = yes
				oe_theme_jurisdiction_size <= 38
			}
			any_subject = {
				oe_kat_eligible_absorb_base = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:oe_kat_lead }
				oe_kat_in_lead_cluster = yes
			}
		}
		ordered_subject = {
			limit = {
				oe_kat_eligible_absorb_base = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:oe_kat_lead }
				oe_kat_in_lead_cluster = yes
			}
			order_by = oe_kat_absorb_priority
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_kat_minor
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_kat_minor
				scope:oe_kat_lead = { oe_kat_combined_jurisdiction_size <= 50 }
			}
			oe_kat_absorb_one_theme = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_kat_merged_last value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# BYZ scope; scope:target_country = chosen Lead Theme to elevate & consolidate into a Diocese Katepanate.
oe_kat_do_consolidate_diocese = {
	scope:target_country = { save_scope_as = oe_kat_lead }
	set_variable = { name = oe_kat_merged_last value = 0 }
	oe_kat_consolidate_one_pass = yes
	oe_kat_consolidate_one_pass = yes
	oe_kat_consolidate_one_pass = yes
	scope:oe_kat_lead = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_kat_is_katepanate value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
		oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 }
		set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_total_formed } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_kat_total_formed value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_kat_total_formed add = 1 }
	}
	oe_kat_sync_modifiers = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_ev_1_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_kat_ev_1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_kat.1
	}
}

# BYZ scope; scope:target_country = active Katepanate to dissolve reversibly back into classical Themes.
oe_kat_do_dissolve_katepanate = {
	scope:target_country = {
		if = { limit = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
		if = { limit = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
		if = { limit = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_kat_is_katepanate } remove_variable = oe_kat_is_katepanate }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod }
		oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 6 }
		set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
	}
	oe_kat_sync_modifiers = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_ev_6_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_kat_ev_6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_kat.6
	}
}

# BYZ scope; Revolt Containment Safeguard — splits loyal absorbed sub-themes off a restive Katepanate
# so any revolt fallout is strictly limited to the Katepanate seat and disloyal holdings.
oe_kat_do_quarantine_split = {
	var:oe_kat_alert_theme ?= {
		if = { limit = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
		if = { limit = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
		if = { limit = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_kat_is_katepanate } remove_variable = oe_kat_is_katepanate }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_kat_katepanate_subject_mod }
		oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 12 }
		set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
	}
	remove_variable = oe_kat_alert_theme
	oe_kat_sync_modifiers = yes
}

# Zero-slot yearly hook invoked from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_kat_ran_y; NEVER forces automatic theme merging.
oe_kat_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_kat_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_kat_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:BYZ
				c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			c:BYZ = {
				oe_kat_sync_modifiers = yes
				if = {
					limit = { oe_kat_active_count >= 1 }
					# Priority 1: Revolt Containment Safeguard for any restive Katepanate (loyalty < 38)
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_containment_global_cd }
							any_subject = {
								oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = yes
								has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty
								var:oe_theme_loyalty < 38
								NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_containment_cd }
							}
						}
						random_subject = {
							limit = {
								oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = yes
								has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty
								var:oe_theme_loyalty < 38
								NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_containment_cd }
							}
							set_variable = { name = oe_kat_containment_cd years = 10 }
							save_scope_as = oe_kat_restive
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = scope:oe_kat_restive }
							set_variable = { name = oe_kat_containment_global_cd years = 5 }
							set_variable = { name = oe_kat_alert_theme value = scope:oe_kat_restive }
							trigger_event_non_silently = oe_kat.4
						}
					}
					# Priority 2: Integrating Civilian Diocese & Military Themes (oe_kat.2)
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_ev_2_done }
							OR = {
								oe_prf_active_dioceses >= 1
								oe_prf_has_active_prefecture = yes
							}
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_kat_ev_2_done value = 1 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_kat.2
					}
					# Priority 3: Protecting the Imperial Naval Themes (oe_kat.3)
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_ev_3_done }
							any_subject = {
								oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
								is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval
							}
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_kat_ev_3_done value = 1 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_kat.3
					}
					# Priority 4: Katepanate Fiscal Dividend (oe_kat.5)
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_kat_ev_5_done }
							OR = {
								oe_kat_active_count >= 2
								AND = {
									oe_kat_active_count >= 1
									oe_prf_active_prefectures >= 2
								}
							}
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_kat_ev_5_done value = 1 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_kat.5
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
